note: What was played in the game. kinds: a template kind played to its win and lose ends. tries: each run, on which game build (exe: as64 = the AS64 build of this repo, mowas2 = the retail MoW:AS2 exe) and how it was started (direct = the test runner's single-player start straight into the mission, menu = through the Single player menu). untried: parts no run has shown yet (patrol = a patrol walking its route, holdfail = a hold goal failed at the timer end, menu = the Single player menu entry, result = the result screen after the end, voices = the silent story/start/outro wav files). Set a kind true, add a try, or drop a part once a run shows it. The GUI card reads this.
